svg.title: The album editor
svg.desc: The album editor, from top to bottom. The header holds the album's title and its actions: Add, Sort, Edit cover, Settings, Preview and Publish. Below it, the album's title, short description and introduction are typed in place, with a line of facts: the count, the span of dates, and how many pictures need alt text, with Review. Then the cover as its band will look, marked Automatic, with Set as cover picture and Edit cover as the ways to change it. A selection bar shows while items are selected, with what they can do. Below it, every item is in a grid of thumbnails in the order shown, some selected, with a text card across the grid between two rows. Beside the grid, the viewer shows one item large with its words to edit: caption, description, alt text with Suggest, date taken and place, downloads, and the other albums it's in.
